iWant: one Squire session always running that I can reach from the Claude app on my Mac and on my phone
soThat: my Squire is there whenever I open the app, without my starting anything
description: The session is kept alive by a launchd agent and comes back by itself after a restart or a crash.
title: Always on: one session, reachable from the Mac and the phone

acceptanceCriteria.description: One Squire session stays running and is reachable from the Claude app on the Mac and on the phone.
acceptanceCriteria.given: Squire installed on a Mac, with its session running and the Claude app signed in on the Mac and the phone
acceptanceCriteria.when: The session is restarted, or it crashes
acceptanceCriteria.then: Within two minutes one Squire session is running again and is listed in the Claude app on both the Mac and the phone.

acceptanceCriteria.description: After the laptop sleeps or is closed, Squire's one session comes back and can be reached.
acceptanceCriteria.given: Squire installed on a laptop, with its session running
acceptanceCriteria.when: The laptop sleeps or is closed, and is then woken or opened
acceptanceCriteria.then: Within two minutes exactly one Squire session is running again, and the Squire owner can reach it.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every session Squire starts runs Squire's safety floor; when the floor cannot be put in place, no session starts and the health check says why.
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire starts its session, or something would let the session run without Squire's safety floor
acceptanceCriteria.then: Every session Squire starts runs Squire's safety floor; when the floor cannot be put in place, no session starts and the health check says why.
